limitations: This archive establishes paired 500-symbol output equivalence and records timings; it does not accept 5,471-symbol performance.
A fixed-500 result cannot establish scaling at the full universe or rule out a full-size-only quadratic hotspot.
Peak bytes are max(main-process OS peak working set, sampled process-tree RSS peak); the 0.5-second tree sampler can miss brief child peaks.
Source-level object/array size estimates are not process RSS measurements.
phase_timer_note: Per-phase medians only; nested inclusive timers overlap and are not summed.
